name: T’ien Wei
bio: T’ien Wei (田為; Tian Wei; fl. c. 1110) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 江神子慢・江城子慢 (Jiang shen zi man / Jiang cheng zi man)
poems.author: T’ien Wei
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
玉台挂秋月。
铅素浅，梅花傅香雪。
冰姿洁。
金莲衬、小小凌波罗袜。
雨初歇。
楼外孤鸿声渐远，远山外、行人音信绝。
此恨对语犹难，那堪更寄书说。
教人红销翠减，觉衣宽金缕，都为轻别。
太情切。
消魂处、画角黄昏时节。
声呜咽。
落尽庭花春去也，银蟾迥、无情圆又缺。
恨伊不似馀香，惹鸳鸯结。
